steps.name: Splash + welcome
steps.detail: Animated OnlyTrusted shield over the Midnight lakescape (~1.4 s). Encrypted stores load off the main thread so the UI never freezes.

steps.name: Your email
steps.detail: Enter the address you want contacted during a distress signal + monitored for breaches. Stored only on your device — not uploaded, never verified via email link.

steps.name: 4-digit PIN
steps.detail: Pick a 4–6 digit PIN. Used as the lock gate + the derivation input for the AES-256-GCM key that encrypts your Vault (PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256, 100k iters). We cannot recover it.

steps.name: Biometric unlock
steps.detail: Toggle Face ID / Touch ID / fingerprint. PIN still required as fallback + for destructive actions. Optional — Skip if you prefer PIN-only.

steps.name: Consent
steps.detail: Plain-text privacy statement + 'I understand' tap. Explicit acknowledgment that OnlyTrusted has no server, no cloud, no account.

features.name: Trusted Contacts (Vault)
features.where: Contacts tab · Dashboard → Emergency Contact Quick Action
features.what: Locally-stored allowlist of people whose calls + SMS always get through. Also the recipient list for Distress Signal.
how: Tap Contacts on the bottom nav
Tap + or Add Contact
Enter manually or Pick from Contacts (one-time read access, only the picked contact is stored)
Save
features.honest: 100% on-device. Does not prevent caller spoofing (Pro's SIM-Swap Alarm helps there).

features.name: Call & SMS Blocking
features.where: Blocked tab · Dashboard → Block Number · Settings → Blocking & Unknown
features.what: Silence or outright block numbers you add to your block list. Optional master toggle: silence ALL calls from numbers not in your Vault.
how: Tap Blocked on the bottom nav
Tap + to add a number
Choose Block calls / Block SMS / both
Add an optional label, Save
features.honest: Android requires granting the default-call-screening role (one-time prompt). iOS uses a Call Directory Extension loaded at install — no network.

features.name: Events Log
features.what: Chronological, searchable, filterable audit of every security event — call blocked, SMS flagged, permission changed, SOS fired, SIM-swap detected, geo-fence exited, etc.
how: Scroll the list (newest first)
Tap any event for full details
Use filter (top-right) to narrow by event type or time range
Use search to find by phone number or event tag
features.honest: 100% on-device. Elite tier adds Merkle-chained hardware-signed entries + Evidence Pack export.

features.name: Contact Safety Scan
features.what: Cross-checks every phone number in your system contacts against the bundled scam-numbers feed. Flags matches with a red warning icon.
how: Settings → Contact Safety Scan
First time: Grant Contacts access (one-time)
Tap Scan contacts for scams
Review flagged contacts (or 'No scam numbers found' banner)
features.honest: Scan runs 100% on-device. Your contact list is never uploaded. Scam feed is bundled.

features.name: Scam SMS Scan
features.what: Scans your SMS inbox against bundled scam numbers, phishing URLs, and classic scam phrases. Flags matches.
how: Settings → Scam SMS Scan
Grant SMS access
Tap Scan my SMS
Review results
features.honest: Android-only — iOS blocks third-party SMS inbox read. iOS uses MessageFilter extension for pre-delivery filtering instead.

features.name: Distress Signal (SOS)
features.where: Red SOS button on Dashboard · Shake 5× in 3s · Volume-down 4× (Android)
features.what: Multi-recipient emergency broadcast with 3-second cancel countdown → SMS to all emergency contacts with location + Google Maps link → auto-opens phone dialer to first contact → opens WhatsApp with pre-filled text + copies group invite link.
how: Add emergency contacts to your Vault with phone numbers
Settings → Distress Signal → toggle shake / volume-down triggers + paste WhatsApp group invite URL
In emergency: tap SOS, shake, or volume-down 4×
Let the 3-second countdown fire (or tap Send Now)
Tap Send in Messages once, tap Call on the dialer, tap Send in WhatsApp
features.honest: Zero network from OnlyTrusted. SMS over carrier GSM; call over PSTN; WhatsApp via your account. WhatsApp group auto-creation blocked by WhatsApp ToS — one-time manual setup required.

features.name: Breach Watch (1 email)
features.what: Monitors 1 email address against a bundled k-anonymity hash database of known breached accounts. Alerts if your email was in a breach.
how: Settings → Breach Watch
Enter the email to monitor
Tap Check now
Review breach list + mitigation advice if any match
features.honest: k-anonymity means your email never leaves the device — only a 5-byte hash prefix is matched. Premium monitors up to 5 emails.

features.name: Private Aliases
features.what: Generates random email aliases for sketchy signups. If an alias leaks, you know which merchant leaked it + disable just that alias without changing your real email.
how: Settings → Private Aliases
Tap Generate new alias
Add a label (what you'll use it for)
Use the alias on the signup form
Configure your chosen relay service (SimpleLogin / Addy.io / Firefox Relay) separately to forward
features.honest: Alias generation is on-device. Forwarding uses your own relay service, not OnlyTrusted. Premium adds CSV export.

features.name: Identity Protection
features.what: Guided checklist with deep-links to official self-service portals: credit freezes (Equifax/Experian/TransUnion), fraud alerts, FTC identity-theft report, SSA account block, HIBP enrollment.
how: Settings → Identity Protection
Tap any checklist item to open the official portal in your browser
Complete the hardening steps there (OnlyTrusted doesn't perform them for you)
features.honest: Deep-links only. Premium adds yearly renewal reminders for actions that expire (fraud alerts, state credit freezes).

features.name: Data Removal Scan
features.what: Shows 50+ people-search sites (Spokeo, Whitepages, Intelius, etc.) with deep-links to each site's opt-out page.
how: Settings → Data Removal Scan
Tap any site to open its opt-out form
Fill out the form (usually name + email + sometimes photo ID)
features.honest: Checklist + deep-links only. OnlyTrusted doesn't scrape or remove anything. Premium adds 90-day re-check reminders since data brokers re-aggregate quickly.

features.name: Blocking & Unknown
features.what: Main configuration for how calls/SMS from numbers not in your Vault are handled. Includes 'Silence calls not in vault' master toggle + handling modes.
how: Settings → Blocking & Unknown
Toggle Silence calls not in vault on/off
Pick Silenced + logged OR Block completely for silenced calls
Pick Silence but keep OR Delete automatically for silenced SMS
features.honest: 100% on-device. Base-level blocking logic that all other tiers extend.

features.name: Notifications
features.what: Per-category toggles for push notifications: call blocked, SMS flagged, permission changes, SIM-swap alerts, check-in reminders, geo-fence exits, weekly digest reminder.
how: Settings → Notifications
Toggle categories individually
Optionally enable Silent Mode for sensitive hours
features.honest: Pure local notifications. No push server. No wake-ups from external triggers.

features.name: Permission Audit
features.what: Lists every OS permission the app currently holds + explains in plain English which feature uses each one. Useful for revoking permissions tied to features you don't use.
how: Settings → Permissions
Review each permission + the feature using it
Tap through to OS Settings to revoke if desired
features.honest: Read-only inspection. Reads the system permission grant state only.

features.name: Device Posture
features.what: Audits device-level security: OS version, auto-lock timeout, biometric enabled, unknown sources (Android), USB debugging. Scored green/yellow/red + links to fix each weak item.
how: Settings → Posture
Review the risk score
Tap Fix this on any red/yellow item to deep-link to the relevant OS setting
features.honest: 100% on-device system state read. Zero network.

features.name: App Lock + Pocket-dial + Screenshot protection
features.where: Settings → App Lock / Pocket-dial / Screenshot protection
features.what: App Lock: PIN/biometric gate on every reopen (configurable timeout). Pocket-dial: proximity + accelerometer detection refuses taps through fabric. Screenshot protection: FLAG_SECURE on every OnlyTrusted screen so no app can capture Vault/Settings.
how: Settings → App Lock → set timeout + biometric preference
Settings → Pocket-dial → toggle
Settings → Screenshot protection → toggle (on by default)
features.honest: Screenshot protection only applies to OnlyTrusted's own screens, not the whole phone.

features.name: Panic Lock + Data Export
features.what: Panic Lock: immediate app lock (destructive-looking red button). Data Export: JSON or CSV of your Vault + events + settings via the OS share-sheet.
how: Panic Lock: Settings → Device & data → Panic Lock (one tap)
Export: Settings → Device & data → Export my data → pick format + destination
features.honest: Export stays encrypted at rest; the exported file is plain text so you can audit it in a spreadsheet.

features.name: Shield Watermark
features.what: Draws an on-screen text watermark with your name + device identifier + timestamp while sensitive screens are open. Deters shoulder-surfing + serves as physical proof-of-ownership on CCTV if the phone is stolen.
how: Settings → Shield Watermark
Toggle on
Customize text (default: 'Protected by OnlyTrusted · <your name>')
features.honest: Android-only — iOS doesn't allow overlays from third-party apps over other app content.

features.name: Privacy Shield
features.what: Monitors which other apps use the microphone and camera. Uses iOS Privacy Dashboard entries + Android SensorPrivacyManager. Alerts + logs every observed capture.
how: Settings → Privacy Shield → toggle on
Grant observer permissions when prompted
Review the Events Log for every mic/camera use by other apps
features.honest: OBSERVE-only, cannot BLOCK other apps from using mic/camera (OS limitation without MDM/root). Monitors system-reported capture events only.

features.name: Breach Watch (up to 5 emails)
features.what: Same engine as Free but enroll up to 5 email addresses — monitor personal + work + school + shared family + secondary.
how: Settings → Breach Watch
Add email → repeat up to 5 times
Check all at once
features.honest: k-anonymity: your emails never leave the device.

features.name: Weekly PDF Digest
features.where: Settings → Weekly Digest · Dashboard Monday banner
features.what: On-demand or auto-generated PDF covering the last 7 days: calls blocked, SMS flagged, top blocklist hits, trusted-contact changes, security events, Honest Limits refresher.
how: Dashboard Monday banner: tap See Full Report
Or Settings → Weekly Digest → Generate now
Share via OS share-sheet (email, cloud, local save)
features.honest: Fully generated on-device. No server round-trip. Share destination is your choice via OS share-sheet.

features.name: Advanced Blocking
features.what: Quiet hours (silence everyone including trusted in a time window) + Area-code allowlist (explicitly allow one or more area codes) + Country allowlist.
how: Settings → Advanced Blocking
Quiet hours: set start/end time + days
Area-code allowlist: add area codes to always ring through
Country allowlist: pick countries to allow international calls from
features.honest: Pure configuration on top of base blocking. 100% on-device.

features.name: Duress Mode
features.what: Second (hidden) PIN at the lock screen. Unlock with the fake PIN to show a decoy Vault + benign event log. Real Vault stays hidden. Simultaneously fires a silent SOS SMS to your pre-chosen emergency contact.
how: Settings → Duress Mode → Enable
Pick duress PIN (must differ from real PIN)
Choose decoy Vault contents (hand-picked)
Choose silent-SOS recipient
Confirm with real PIN + biometric
features.honest: 100% on-device decoy. Silent SMS via carrier. Last-resort feature for coercion scenarios — not a toy.

features.name: App Permission Watchdog
features.what: Daily auto-audit of every installed app's sensitive permissions. Compares against baseline; full-screen alert if any app gained a new sensitive permission since last check.
how: Settings → App Permission Watchdog → toggle on
Grant QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES (Android) when prompted
Daily audit runs automatically; alerts shown when changes detected
features.honest: 100% on-device audit. Baseline stored locally. No network. Catches updates that silently added permissions.

features.name: SIM-Swap Alarm
features.what: On every app launch, reads SIM IMSI + ICCID + carrier operator. Compares against baseline. Full-screen non-dismissable alert if any identifier changed.
how: Settings → SIM-Swap Alarm → Enable
App snapshots your current SIM identifiers as baseline
On any subsequent SIM change: alert fires, with Yes/No/Not sure options
features.honest: On-device SIM identifier read. Zero network to verify. Detects swap on next app launch (not instantly).

features.name: Wangiri Protection
features.what: Detects the one-ring-and-cut scam pattern (rings <2s then hangs up, often international, aiming to trick you into calling back a premium number).
how: Settings → Wangiri Protection → Enable
Watcher runs in background (foreground service on Android)
Detected numbers show in Events Log with Wangiri tag
features.honest: Android: full auto-block (number added to block list). iOS: detect-only (CallKit doesn't expose caller number to third parties — must manually block via Recents → Block Contact).

features.name: Smart Link Guard
features.what: URL inspection in three places: incoming SMS (checks URLs against bundled phishing feed), QR scanner (on-device ML Kit / Vision), share-sheet 'Scan this URL' extension (long-press any URL anywhere).
how: Settings → Smart Link Guard → toggle sub-features individually
SMS: automatic on incoming messages
QR: open the Smart Link Guard screen and point camera at QR
Share-sheet: long-press any URL anywhere in iOS/Android → pick 'Scan with OnlyTrusted'
features.honest: 100% on-device URL validation against bundled 50k-entry phishing feed. Zero network.

features.name: Safety Check-In
features.what: Scheduled check-ins. You tap 'I'm OK' within a grace period or OnlyTrusted silently sends your location to pre-chosen emergency contacts.
how: Settings → Safety Check-In → Schedule
Pick times + days + grace period (default 10 min)
Pick emergency SMS recipients
At each scheduled check-in: notification → tap I'm OK → done. If missed: silent SMS fires with location
features.honest: 100% on-device logic. SMS over your carrier network.

features.name: Tracker Finder
features.what: BLE scan for nearby trackers (AirTag, Tile, SmartTag, Chipolo). If the same unknown tracker appears repeatedly in your path 15+ minutes apart → alert.
how: Settings → Tracker Finder → toggle on
Grant BLUETOOTH_SCAN + optional Location permission
Scan runs continuously (foreground service on Android; foreground-only on iOS)
features.honest: iOS: Apple's native 'unknown accessory' detection is more thorough + runs system-wide. OnlyTrusted supplements. Range: 10–30m indoors.

features.name: App Shield
features.what: Walks you through iOS Screen Time (FamilyControls) or Android Digital Wellbeing to lock specific apps behind biometric unlock. Pick apps that need biometric to open — social media, banking, etc.
how: Settings → App Shield → Setup
Grant ScreenTime / Digital Wellbeing API access
Pick apps to lock
Each future launch requires Face ID / fingerprint
features.honest: Uses the OS-provided locking mechanism — not a parallel OnlyTrusted engine. OS consistency makes this reliable; limitations vary by Android OEM.

features.name: Border Mode
features.what: One-tap preset for hostile travel: enables Duress Mode → Airplane Mode on → silences all notifications → locks the app → arms Dead-Man Wipe countdown (default 7 days).
how: Settings → Border Mode → Arm
Confirm with PIN + biometric + Hardware Key (if enrolled)
To disarm: unlock the app (same auth chain) within the countdown
features.honest: 100% on-device state change + OS Airplane Mode toggle. Zero network (Airplane Mode cuts all radios).

features.name: Panic Lockdown
features.where: Settings → Panic Lockdown · Dashboard arm button if enabled
features.what: Immediate full-pressure armor: lock + Duress arm + aggressive sensor monitoring + Smart Link Guard SMS watcher disabled + PIN-only unlock until next device reboot.
how: Settings → Panic Lockdown → one-tap Arm
App enters lockdown immediately
To exit: reboot the device, then unlock with real PIN
features.honest: Nuclear option. Aggressive monitoring may drain battery. PIN-only forces resistance to coerced biometric unlock.

features.name: Hardware Security Key
features.what: Enroll a FIDO2 YubiKey / Titan / SoloKey. Required for destructive actions: Wipe Everything, Duress disable, Encrypted Backup export, Dead-Man disable, Vault restore.
how: Settings → Hardware Security Key → Enroll
Tap/insert your FIDO2 key when prompted
After enrollment: destructive actions prompt for key tap
features.honest: iOS requires NFC-capable key (tap to back of phone). Android: USB-C or NFC.

features.name: Voice Biometric
features.what: For each trusted contact, record 10 seconds of them saying a specific phrase. On incoming calls, if they repeat the phrase, OnlyTrusted compares via MFCC fingerprint (cosine similarity ≥0.6 = match). Warns if mismatch (possible AI-cloned voice).
how: Settings → Voice Biometric → Enroll contact
Pick a trusted contact + record their 10s phrase
On future calls from them, OnlyTrusted compares the first 2–3s if they say the phrase
features.honest: 100% on-device MFCC fingerprinting. MFCC is not reversible (can't reconstruct voice). Accuracy ~90–95%. False negatives if voice changes (cold, accent).

features.name: Face-Change Lock
features.what: While sensitive OnlyTrusted screens are open, front camera watches quietly. Different face appears → app instantly locks. No face for a few seconds → screen blurs (shoulder-surf defense).
how: Settings → Face-Change Lock → Enroll your face
Grant Camera access
On sensitive screens: camera runs; locks on stranger-face or blurs on no-face
features.honest: iOS Vision framework is more mature; Android support varies by OEM. All processing on-device.

features.name: Geo-fence Auto-Lock
features.what: Define up to 5 trusted locations. When device exits all of them, app auto-locks + sends silent SMS alert to designated contacts: '<name>'s phone left trusted locations at <timestamp>, location: <maps-url>'.
how: Settings → Geo-fence Auto-Lock → Add trusted location (home / work / etc.)
Grant Always Location permission
Pick alert recipients
On any exit from all 5 geo-fences: auto-lock + SMS fires
features.honest: 100% on-device geofence logic. SMS via carrier. Accuracy ±5–30m in urban areas.

features.name: Dead-Man Wipe
features.what: If you don't unlock the app for N days (default 7, configurable 1–30), it irreversibly wipes Vault + events + encrypted data. For hostile travel, witness protection, dead-man-switch scenarios.
how: Settings → Dead-Man Wipe → Enable
Pick days (1–30)
Confirm with PIN + biometric + Hardware Key (if enrolled)
To reset countdown: just unlock the app. To disable: full auth + Trusted Witness approval
features.honest: Device power-off resets countdown. Attacker who holds the phone unpowered defeats this.

features.name: Encrypted Backup
features.what: Export entire Vault + settings to a single .ot2bak file, AES-256-GCM encrypted with a key derived from your PIN. Safe to store on Google Drive / iCloud / Dropbox / email.
how: Settings → Encrypted Backup → Export
Confirm with Hardware Key (if enrolled)
Pick storage destination via OS share-sheet
features.honest: Backup file is opaque to cloud providers. Only decryptable with your PIN.

features.name: Restore from Backup
features.what: Pick a .ot2bak file + enter PIN + decrypt + overwrite current Vault. For new devices or disaster recovery.
how: Settings → Restore from Backup
Pick file via file picker (SAF on Android / Files app on iOS)
Enter PIN + Hardware Key tap
Confirm overwrite
features.honest: 100% on-device decryption.

features.name: Shamir Split
features.what: Splits Vault master key into M-of-N shares (e.g., 3-of-5) using Shamir Secret Sharing. Distribute via BLE to trusted shareholders. Recover with M shareholders physically near you.
how: Settings → Shamir Split → Setup
Pick M-of-N threshold (3-of-5 recommended)
Approach each shareholder with their OnlyTrusted installed; share transfers via BLE
Recovery: ask M shareholders to bring their devices near yours + approve
features.honest: Zero network — all BLE peer-to-peer. Removes single-point-of-failure of your PIN.

features.name: Trusted Witness
features.what: Designate up to 5 friends as witnesses. Destructive actions (Wipe, Duress disable, Dead-Man disable, Backup export) require at least one witness device nearby via BLE + their approval.
how: Settings → Trusted Witness → Add witness
Approach their phone via BLE pairing
Future destructive actions prompt for witness-nearby + their approval on their device
features.honest: Prevents coercion: attacker with your PIN still can't wipe your Vault alone.

features.name: Steganographic Vault
features.what: Hides encrypted Vault inside a decoy PNG image or PDF via LSB (least-significant-bit) steganography. Looks like a normal photo; actually contains your Vault.
how: Settings → Steganographic Vault → Setup
Pick a decoy image/PDF (something inconspicuous)
OnlyTrusted embeds the encrypted Vault inside the image's pixel LSBs
To access: tap the image via Steganographic Vault → decrypts to Vault
features.honest: Image quality slightly degraded (invisible to human eye). Combine with Duress Mode for maximum plausible deniability.

features.name: Signed Audit Log
features.what: Every security event cryptographically signed by Hardware Key + Merkle-chained. Export an Evidence Pack admissible in court as proof that events occurred at specific times + weren't retroactively edited.
how: Enroll Hardware Key first
Settings → Signed Audit Log → Enable
Every event is signed as it occurs
Export Evidence Pack: Settings → Signed Audit Log → Export → generates .zip with signed log + Merkle proofs + verifier
features.honest: Primary use: survivor + prosecutor evidence in abuse/stalking cases. Evidence pack is cryptographically verifiable offline.

features.name: Rogue Network Scanner
features.what: Three continuous checks: IMSI-catcher detection (notices silent LTE→2G downgrade), rogue Wi-Fi SSID detection (flags lookalike names like 'Starbuks' vs 'Starbucks'), hotel Wi-Fi downgrade (same SSID + different BSSID).
how: Settings → Rogue Network Scanner → Enable
Grant Location + Wi-Fi state read
Alerts fire via notification when heuristics match
features.honest: Heuristic detection ~70–80% accurate. False positives possible in low-signal areas.

features.name: Offline Threat Intel
features.what: Browse the bundled threat-intel feeds the app ships with: 50k+ phishing hosts, scam phone numbers, Pegasus/Candiru/Predator IoCs, breach-hash prefixes.
how: Settings → Threat Intel
Browse any feed to see what OnlyTrusted knows about threats
Updates ship via normal app updates (not live-fetched)
features.honest: 100% bundled, zero live-fetch. Updates follow app binary cadence.

platformDiffs.note: iOS CallKit doesn't expose caller number

honestLimits: Cannot monitor other apps' microphone or camera use at a hardware level without root (Android) or MDM (iOS). Privacy Shield observes only what the OS exposes.
Cannot stop someone on a video call from recording their own screen or filming your face with another device.
Cannot block screenshots of OTHER apps. FLAG_SECURE only applies to OnlyTrusted's own screens.
Cannot make your phone untrackable by your carrier, ISP, or OS vendor.
Cannot block all spam calls. Carrier-level paths bypass Android call screening; iOS CallKit misses some.
Cannot detect in-call voice-cloning / deepfake audio in real time. Neither platform exposes live call audio to third-party apps. Mitigation: Voice Biometric (Elite) + pre-shared family passphrase.
Cannot auto-block Wangiri numbers on iOS. CallKit doesn't give us the number — detect-only.
Cannot read your SMS inbox on iOS. iOS reserves this for Mail + Messages.
Cannot create a WhatsApp group for you. WhatsApp ToS reserves that to its own UI — manual one-time setup required.
Cannot guarantee Dead-Man Wipe fires if the device loses power before the countdown completes. Rebooting resets the countdown.
Cannot recover your PIN or Vault if you've forgotten both your PIN and never set up Shamir Split or Encrypted Backup. There is nowhere to recover from — by design.

faq.q: My SOS button is grayed out — why?
faq.a: You need at least one Trusted Contact with a valid phone number in your Vault. Add one via Contacts tab → +.

Verify under Settings → Distress Signal that Shake phone to trigger is toggled on. Shake detection runs only when the app is in the foreground — both platforms block background shake listeners for third-party apps.
This is opt-in and off by default. Enable it under Settings → Distress Signal → Volume-down 4× to trigger. The 4-press pattern must land within 2 seconds AND the OnlyTrusted app must be foreground.

faq.q: I lost my phone — can I log in from a new one?
faq.a: No, because there is no account. Your Vault lives in encrypted storage on the lost device. To restore: install OnlyTrusted, go to Settings → Restore from Backup (Elite) + load your .ot2bak file. If you didn't set up Encrypted Backup OR Shamir Split, your data is gone.

faq.q: How do I verify OnlyTrusted isn't phoning home?
faq.a: Three ways: (1) Install NetGuard (Android) or Lockdown Privacy (iOS) + watch — OnlyTrusted shows zero outbound connections. (2) Inspect AndroidManifest.xml + Info.plist in the public source. (3) Verify the SLSA Build Provenance attestation on any GitHub release matches.
